agent.bio_long: Justin Kirkwood is a top-producing luxury real estate specialist with Luxe Properties and was recognized in South Florida Agent Magazine's Who's Who 2026. Justin is widely regarded as the best listing agent across Coral Gables, Pinecrest, Cutler Bay, Kendall, and South Miami. He combines deep, neighborhood-level market knowledge with aggressive, data-driven marketing to get his sellers the highest possible price and his buyers a real edge. Whether you are selling a Coral Gables luxury estate, buying a Pinecrest family home, or weighing a condo versus a townhome in South Miami, Justin is the local authority South Florida homeowners trust.
